source_meta.issue links: Relates:inward:MC-259789:Subtitle for equipping a shield in the offhand is generic | Relates:outward:MC-98316:Wrong subtitles caused by missing distinction
source_meta._title: Equipping a player head, skull or carved pumpkin displays the generic "Gear equips" subtitle

stor.recommended_version: Minecraft Java Edition 1.19 Pre-release 1 (launcher version ID: 1.19-pre1)
stor.environment: Minecraft Java Edition client in a clean single-player Creative-mode world, with English (US) selected, game audio active, and subtitles enabled.
preconditions: The Minecraft Launcher can install and run historical snapshots and pre-releases.
Use exactly Java Edition 1.19 Pre-release 1; do not create or open the reproduction world in a different version.
A new single-player Creative-mode world is sufficient. The report specifies no seed, coordinates, dimension, difficulty, server, or multiplayer requirement.
The plan uses an Iron Chestplate as the report's armor comparison item and a Carved Pumpkin as the affected headwear item.
Use the configured equivalents if the default Inventory key E or other controls have been rebound.
Begin with the player's head and chest armor slots empty.

steps.action: In the Minecraft Launcher, open Installations, enable the Snapshots version category, create an installation using version 1.19-pre1, and launch that installation. Historical pre-releases are exposed through the launcher snapshot option. ([feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/6319694424845-Minecraft-Java-Edition-1-19-Pre-Release-1?utm_source=openai))
steps.exact_input: Installations -> Snapshots: enabled -> New Installation -> Version: 1.19-pre1 -> Create -> Play
steps.success_cue: Minecraft reaches the main menu and identifies the running version as 1.19 Pre-release 1.

steps.action: From the main menu, create a new single-player world in Creative mode. Leave the seed and all other world-generation options at their defaults.
steps.exact_input: Singleplayer -> Create New World -> Game Mode: Creative -> Create New World
steps.success_cue: The player spawns in a newly generated world and can fly or access the Creative inventory.

steps.action: Wait before configuring or equipping anything until initial world and chunk loading has finished.
steps.success_cue: Nearby terrain is rendered, the loading overlay is gone, and movement and menu inputs respond normally.

steps.action: Open the pause menu, enter the language menu, select English (US), and confirm the selection. This keeps the subtitle language consistent with the report.
steps.success_cue: Menu labels are displayed in English and the Options screen is visible again.

steps.action: Open Music & Sounds settings and ensure Master Volume is not muted. A value such as 100% is suitable.
steps.success_cue: Master Volume displays a nonzero value.

steps.action: In Music & Sounds settings, toggle subtitles on.
steps.success_cue: The setting reads Show Subtitles: ON.

steps.action: Select Done until all option menus close and normal world view returns.
steps.success_cue: The player is back in the world with no menu open.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory using the Inventory control.
steps.success_cue: The Creative inventory interface opens and displays category tabs and the hotbar.

steps.action: Select the Search Items tab, click its search field, and search for the comparison armor item.
steps.success_cue: An item result named Iron Chestplate is visible in the Creative inventory results.

steps.action: Hover the pointer over the Iron Chestplate result and press the hotbar key for slot 1 to copy the item into that slot.
steps.success_cue: An Iron Chestplate is visible in hotbar slot 1 at the bottom of the inventory screen.

steps.action: Select all text in the Creative inventory search field and replace it with the affected headwear item's name.
steps.success_cue: An item result named Carved Pumpkin is visible in the Creative inventory results.

steps.action: Hover the pointer over the Carved Pumpkin result and press the hotbar key for slot 2 to copy the item into that slot.
steps.success_cue: A Carved Pumpkin is visible in hotbar slot 2, while the Iron Chestplate remains in hotbar slot 1.

steps.action: Click the Survival Inventory tab in the Creative inventory. In this version, this is the chest-icon tab that opens the player inventory view containing the player model, crafting grid, and armor slots.
steps.exact_input: Left-click the chest-icon Survival Inventory tab
steps.success_cue: The player model and four vertical armor slots are visible, including the top head slot and the chest slot directly below it.

steps.action: Inspect the top head armor slot and the chest armor slot. If either contains an item, remove it to an unused inventory or hotbar slot before continuing.
steps.exact_input: If occupied: left-click the armor item, then left-click an empty inventory slot
steps.success_cue: Both the head and chest armor slots are empty; the Carved Pumpkin remains in hotbar slot 2 and the Iron Chestplate remains available in hotbar slot 1.

steps.action: Left-click the Iron Chestplate in hotbar slot 1 to attach it to the mouse cursor.
steps.success_cue: The Iron Chestplate icon follows the mouse cursor and hotbar slot 1 is empty.

steps.action: Left-click the chest armor slot beside the player model to equip the Iron Chestplate. Inventory-slot equipping is the sound-producing armor path relevant to this pre-release. ([feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/6319694424845-Minecraft-Java-Edition-1-19-Pre-Release-1?utm_source=openai))
steps.success_cue: The Iron Chestplate occupies the chest armor slot, appears on the player model, and no item remains attached to the cursor.

steps.action: Immediately close the inventory so the subtitle area of the normal game view can be checked.
steps.success_cue: Normal world view returns, the player is wearing the Iron Chestplate, and a fresh subtitle notification from the comparison equip action is visible near the lower-right corner.

steps.action: Do not move, interact, or produce additional sounds. Wait until the comparison equip subtitle has completely disappeared, so it cannot be confused with the next equip event.
steps.success_cue: No subtitle from the Iron Chestplate equip action remains visible.

steps.action: Open the Creative inventory again and return to the Survival Inventory tab if the armor slots are not already displayed.
steps.exact_input: E, then left-click the chest-icon Survival Inventory tab if needed
steps.success_cue: The armor slots are visible, the Iron Chestplate remains in the chest slot, the head slot is empty, and the Carved Pumpkin is present in hotbar slot 2.

steps.action: Left-click the Carved Pumpkin in hotbar slot 2 to attach it to the mouse cursor.
steps.success_cue: The Carved Pumpkin icon follows the mouse cursor, hotbar slot 2 is empty, and the head armor slot remains empty.

steps.action: Left-click the top head armor slot to equip the Carved Pumpkin. Official notes for this exact pre-release identify placing pumpkins or skulls into the headwear slot as the relevant sound-producing action. ([feedback.minecraft.net](https://feedback.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/6319694424845-Minecraft-Java-Edition-1-19-Pre-Release-1?utm_source=openai))
steps.exact_input: Left-click the top head armor slot
steps.success_cue: The Carved Pumpkin occupies the head armor slot, appears on the player model, and no item remains attached to the cursor.

steps.action: Immediately close the inventory without clicking, moving items, or performing any other sound-producing action.
steps.success_cue: Normal world view has just returned, the Carved Pumpkin is equipped, and no unrelated action has occurred since the headwear equip action.

stor.handoff_condition: The Carved Pumpkin has just been placed into the player's head armor slot in Java Edition 1.19 Pre-release 1, and the inventory has immediately been closed. Begin subtitle observation before the equip-event subtitle fades.
uncertainties: The report does not specify a game mode, world seed, dimension, difficulty, or server type; a new single-player Creative world is used only as the simplest deterministic way to obtain the required items.
The report permits any armor piece or elytra for the comparison action. This plan uses an Iron Chestplate so the head slot remains free for the affected item.

The report permits a player head, another skull, or a carved pumpkin for the affected action. This plan tests a Carved Pumpkin; the alternate head and skull variants would require separate repetitions after clearing the head slot and waiting for the previous subtitle to disappear.
Default Java Edition keyboard and mouse bindings are described; rebound controls must use their configured equivalents.
